description: Least-privilege MCP tool profiles. Default posture is read-only. Elevation requires explicit per-task activation.

read-only.description: Documentation and read-only operations. Active by default.

context7.rationale: Documentation-only SSE server with no write capability

standard.description: Read-only plus GitHub read operations. Requires explicit activation.

context7.rationale: Documentation-only SSE server with no write capability

github.rationale: Read-only GitHub operations for context gathering

elevated.description: Full access to all MCP servers including write operations. Requires explicit per-task activation.

github.rationale: Full GitHub operations including write (create issues, PRs, comments)

azure.rationale: Full Azure operations including resource provisioning

terraform.rationale: Full Terraform operations including plan and apply

activationInstructions.read-only: Active by default. No action required.
activationInstructions.standard: Set 'copilot.mcpProfile' to 'standard' in .vscode/settings.json or activate via /deploy skill.
activationInstructions.elevated: Set 'copilot.mcpProfile' to 'elevated' in .vscode/settings.json. Required for infrastructure changes, PR creation, and deployment operations.
